title: [Keyboard Manager] Hitting the Alt key or the G key controls muting and unmuting the microphone

status.label: Identify what handles the microphone shortcut
status.detail: The report says Alt or G toggles microphone mute on PowerToys 0.94.1 but does not identify a Keyboard Manager mapping, the microphone app, or whether the behavior occurs with PowerToys disabled.

judgment.rationale: The report lists PowerToys 0.94.1 running elevated and says pressing Alt or G toggles microphone mute. It does not identify any Keyboard Manager mapping or the application/device that controls the microphone. The only comment suggests a clearer title and adds no diagnostic evidence. Confirming whether the behavior occurs with Keyboard Manager disabled, and which app is active, will distinguish a PowerToys remap from another application's or system component's shortcut.
evidence: The issue lists PowerToys 0.94.1 from the Microsoft Store and says it is running elevated.
The report says the Alt key or G key toggles microphone mute, but gives no numbered reproduction steps.
No Keyboard Manager mapping or other software is identified in the report.
The single comment only suggests a title change and does not clarify the cause.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether either key still toggles mute with Keyboard Manager disabled and which application is active when the behavior occurs.

fix_assessment.rationale: The symptom is clear, but no Keyboard Manager mapping, trigger context, or application responsible for microphone mute is identified. A PowerToys fix path cannot be justified until the behavior is isolated from other software or system shortcuts.

issue_context.summary: The reporter says pressing Alt or G toggles microphone mute, but the issue does not identify a Keyboard Manager mapping or the app controlling the microphone.

issue_context.analysis: The report lacks the context needed to assign the mute toggle to Keyboard Manager. Ask whether it persists with Keyboard Manager disabled and identify the foreground application during the event; then reassess the responsible input path.
initial_investigation: Read the current issue body, labels, assignees, and the only comment.

information_gaps.information: Whether pressing Alt or G alone toggles microphone mute with Keyboard Manager disabled, and which application is active when it happens
information_gaps.why_needed: This isolates a PowerToys remap from a microphone application's, device's, or Windows' own shortcut handling.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Repeat the same key presses once with Keyboard Manager disabled, note the foreground application and microphone device, and report which key triggers the toggle.

comment.body: The report says Alt or G toggles microphone mute on PowerToys 0.94.1, but does not list a Keyboard Manager mapping or the app that handles the microphone. Could you confirm whether pressing either key alone still toggles mute with Keyboard Manager disabled, and which application is active when it happens? This will help determine whether the shortcut is coming from PowerToys or another app/system component.
